exposure: normotensive throughout pregnancy and in the first 6 weeks postpartum
outcome: de novo hypertension (BP abnormalities per American College of Cardiology-American Heart Association criteria)
cohort: The study included all patients delivering within an academic health care system who remained normotensive throughout pregnancy and in the first 6 weeks postpartum.
finding: Nearly one-fifth of the large cohort, previously normotensive during pregnancy and early postpartum, developed blood pressure abnormalities by 6 months postpartum.
